label: Idriss (2008)
units: PGA, PSA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are anchor_only - one anchor branch (PGA / headline branch) is reproducible from the specification appendix, but the spectral table and a median kernel are not in the repository - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Idriss (2008)

magnitude.note: alpha1/alpha2 switch at Mw 6.75: 3.7066/-0.1252 below, 5.6315/-0.4104 above.

site.note: A correction applies for Vs30 > 900 m/s. This is not a continuous nonlinear site model - do not generalise it into one.

mechanism.note: A single fault-style term phi(T)*F in the published equation.
mechanism.anchor_note: A single fault-style flag F with coefficient 0.12. Which classes F encodes is still not stated.

published_grid_summary.note: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table) gives the count and range only; Idriss (2008) has no OpenQuake implementation (only idriss_2014.py) and the paper is not openly available. Still RESOLVE.

parameters.equation: ln(PSA) = alpha1(T) + alpha2(T)*M - [beta1(T) + beta2(T)*M]*ln(Rrup + 10) + gamma(T)*Rrup + phi(T)*F

coefficients.needed: The period-dependent SPECTRAL table for alpha1, alpha2, beta1, beta2, gamma and phi. PGA/headline values, the magnitude break, the sigma expression and the high-Vs30 correction are now available.

implementation_notes: Test above and below the magnitude breakpoint and around Vs30 = 900 m/s.
parameters.sigma_rule: 1.28 + 0.05*ln(T) - 0.08*M, capped at M=5 and M=7.5; for T<0.05 use T=0.05

resolution_provenance.distance.min_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): rmin 0.3 km (rrup)
resolution_provenance.distance.max_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): rmax 199.3 km (rrup); Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, section 2.258: records from > 200 km excluded
resolution_provenance.mechanism.classes: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, section 2.258: F = 0 strike-slip (rake within 30 deg of horizontal; normal events included); F = 1 reverse (rake within 30 deg of vertical upwards; reverse-oblique and normal-oblique included)
resolution_provenance.periods.t_min_s: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): Tmin 0.01 s
resolution_provenance.component: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table) and Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): component code I50
